The rig runtime renders <root-portal> in place, so the dropdown's fixed layer stays inside the sheet (backdrop-filter containing block + overflow clip). Move the opened layer under the page's theme root inside a shadow host that carries cy-dropdown's own styles; listeners stay on the moved nodes; product code/styles untouched. */let L=null,H=null;const f=(r)=>{for(const e of r.querySelectorAll('*')){if(e.shadowRoot)f(e.shadowRoot);if(!L&&/cdd__layer/.test(String(e.className||''))){L=e;}}};f(document);if(!L)return 'no layer';let r=L;while(r&&r.nodeType!==11)r=r.parentNode;H=r.host;let T=H;while(T&&!(T.classList&&(T.classList.contains('theme-dark')||T.classList.contains('theme-topic-editor')))){T=T.assignedSlot||T.parentNode;if(T&&T.nodeType===11)T=T.host;}if(!T)return 'no theme root';const box=document.createElement('div');box.setAttribute('data-rig','root-portal');T.appendChild(box);const sr=box.attachShadow({mode:'open'});sr.adoptedStyleSheets=r.adoptedStyleSheets;for(const s of r.querySelectorAll('style,link[rel=stylesheet]'))sr.appendChild(s.cloneNode(true));sr.appendChild(L);const p=L.querySelector('.cdd__panel').getBoundingClientRect();return 'moved to '+T.className+'; panel y='+Math.round(p.y)+' h='+Math.round(p.height)})()
